create.name: Maureen Hancock
create.bio:
Maureen Hancock is a spirit medium, intuitive teacher and author based in the Bridgewater area of Massachusetts. Before working full time as a medium she was a litigation manager, and for more than 25 years she has focused on helping people talk more openly about death, dying and grief. She wrote The Medium Next Door: Adventures of a Real-Life Ghost Whisperer and was the subject of the Style Network documentary Psychic in Suburbia (2011). She volunteers with hospice, sits with bereaved parents and has assisted families and law enforcement in missing-person cases.

Her teaching centres on intuition and spirit communication: recognising signs from loved ones who have died, clearing what she calls the clutter that blocks connection, and testing and trusting intuitive impressions. She runs Maureen Hancock University, an online school of self-paced semesters with meditations and lessons, and teaches workshops for law enforcement, medical professionals and the public. Her Postcards from Heaven evenings of group readings tour New England, and she leads Soul Shift retreats on Cape Cod and in Costa Rica that combine meditation, breathwork, intuitive exercises and mediumship. She founded The Zen Loft, a yoga and wellness centre in Bridgewater, and teaches courses on The Shift Network.

books.title: The Medium Next Door: Adventures of a Real-Life Ghost Whisperer
books.author: Maureen Hancock
books.description: Her account of growing up with and coming to terms with her ability as a medium, told through stories of readings and messages from people who have died. It also offers her view of what happens after death and how to notice signs from loved ones.

courses.title: Investigative Mediumship
courses.description: A seven-week live video course on The Shift Network that uses photographs, objects, maps and real-life mysteries as practice for mediumship. You learn to follow a first impression further, receive information through more than one sense, and test and validate what comes through; sessions are recorded.

courses.title: Maureen Hancock University
courses.description: An online school of self-paced semesters in a classroom-style format, with video lessons and meditations on intuition, signs from spirit and becoming a clear channel for messages. It also covers grief and finding purpose.
courses.price: $249 USD per year or $25 USD per month

courses.title: Soul Shift Retreat, Cape Cod
courses.description: A weekend retreat at the Wequassett Resort in Harwich on Cape Cod. Sessions may include gentle movement, meditation and breathwork, intuitive and mediumship exercises, sound and relaxation practices, and journaling.

courses.title: Soul Shift Costa Rica Retreat
courses.description: Her sixth annual week-long retreat at the Imiloa Institute in Costa Rica. Daily workshops cover spirit communication, intuitive development and past-life regression, alongside optional yoga, sound baths and a Postcards from Heaven group reading.

free_resources.title: Flexing Your Intuitive Muscle
free_resources.description: A free guided audio in which Maureen leads simple exercises for fine-tuning your intuition and reaching a calmer, clearer state.

Not to be confused with Graham Hancock, who is already on Spiritpedia (different person).
Investigative Mediumship (Shift) starts 4 Nov 2026 as a 7-week live course; end date not published (likely mid-December 2026).
Retreat prices are not published on the event pages, so 'Contact for pricing'; both retreats are dated and need removing after they end.
Costa Rica retreat page lists an acupressure/shiatsu clinic and 'nervous system regulation' among activities; kept as non-claims but left out of our description.
Video 'Grief Relief' kept: grief treated as emotional, not medical; a human may prefer to drop it.
Her YouTube videos are 5 to 12 years old; several are lessons from Maureen Hancock University.
She describes herself as a 'holistic healer'; the bio does not repeat this.
